stem.en: A flat area of rock runs out from the foot of a sea cliff, between the tide levels. How did it form?

text.en: Sand set hard after being laid down by waves.

feedback.en: The platform is the old rock itself, not new rock made from sand.

text.en: Waves wore the land back and left this rock.

feedback.en: Right. It marks where the cliff used to stand.

text.en: A river deposited mud at the foot of the cliff.

feedback.en: Rivers lay down mud at their mouths. This is bare wave-cut rock.

text.en: The sea floor rose up during an earthquake.

feedback.en: Nothing rose. Waves cut it as the cliff retreated.

explanation.en: Waves cut at the foot of the cliff, and the rock above falls. As the cliff retreats, the lower rock that the waves wore flat is left behind as a shore platform.

hints.en: Where was the cliff before it moved back?
